info.title: eBay E-Commerce API
info.description: A full-featured e-commerce REST API powering the eBay storefront. Provides endpoints for user authentication, product catalog browsing, shopping cart management, order processing with coupons and delivery tracking, wishlists, product reviews and Q&A, blog posts and comments, coupon administration, contact messages, issue reports, price-match requests, repair bookings, and simulated payment processing.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: User authentication, registration, profile management, and account operations

tags.name: Contact
tags.description: Public contact form submission and admin-only message review

tags.name: Coupons
tags.description: Discount coupon management (admin only) and coupon validation at checkout (any authenticated user)

tags.name: Issues
tags.description: Post-delivery issue reports filed by buyers and triaged by admins (requires authentication)

tags.name: Price Match
tags.description: Buyer price match request submission and admin approve/reject review flow

tags.name: Questions
tags.description: Product Q&A: buyers ask questions and upvote them, sellers and admins post answers

tags.name: Repairs
tags.description: Schedule and track in-warranty repair requests for products from delivered orders

get.description:
Mints a short-lived Argide/OurGuide verification token for the currently authenticated user. The token is an HS256 JWT signed with the server-side Argide secret (ARGIDE_AUTH_SECRET, falling back to OURGUIDE_AUTH_SECRET or OURGUIDE_VERIFICATION_SECRET) and carries the claims `user_id`, `email`, `name` and `exp`. It expires 1 hour (3600 seconds) after it is issued. The browser passes this token to the Argide widget via the `identify` command, and other API routes accept it back through the `x-argide-token` / `x-ourguide-token` header.

Available to any authenticated user; no specific role is required.

Authentication note: unlike most endpoints, this route authenticates with `getAppAuthUser`, which only accepts the application JWT — either an `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header or the `ebay-session` cookie. An Argide verification token presented in the `x-argide-token` header is **not** accepted here, so a minted token cannot be used to mint another one.

If the Argide secret environment variable is not configured, the signing step throws and the route responds with 500 and the message "ARGIDE_AUTH_SECRET is not set".

401.description: No valid application session (missing or invalid Bearer token / ebay-session cookie)

500.description: Token could not be signed. The response carries the thrown error's message, most commonly because the Argide signing secret is not configured on the server.

post.description: Clears the `ebay-session` cookie by re-issuing it with an empty value and `Max-Age=0`. This endpoint requires no authentication and always succeeds, even when no session cookie is present. Note that only the cookie is cleared: a JWT held by the client (for example one sent via the `Authorization: Bearer` header) is not revoked server-side and stays valid until it expires.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of blog posts sorted by publish date (newest first), falling back to creation date. Only posts with status "published" are returned, unless `admin=true` is supplied together with a valid token belonging to a user whose role is "admin" — in that case draft posts are included as well. If `admin=true` is supplied without an admin token the request still succeeds but silently returns only published posts. Results can be narrowed by category and by a single tag. The response body carries the pagination echo fields `total`, `page` and `limit` alongside the `posts` array. Note that each list item omits the post `content` field; use GET /api/blog/{slug} to read the full body.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Non-numeric or values below 1 are clamped to 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of posts per page. Clamped to the range 1–50.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter posts by category slug (exact match).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter posts that contain this tag. Tags are stored lowercase.

parameters.name: admin
parameters.description: Set to "true" to include draft posts. Only honoured when the request also carries a token for a user with the "admin" role; otherwise it is ignored.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the blog post list

posts.title: The Best Wireless Headphones of 2026
posts.excerpt: Our picks for the best noise-cancelling wireless headphones you can buy right now.
posts.metaDescription: Our picks for the best noise-cancelling wireless headphones you can buy right now.

post.description: Creates a new blog post. Requires the "admin" role. The request body is `multipart/form-data` because it may carry a featured image file, which is uploaded to Cloudinary under the "blog" folder. The submitted slug is lowercased, trimmed and sanitised (every character outside `a-z0-9-` is replaced with `-`, and runs of `-` are collapsed) before it is stored; slug uniqueness is checked against the raw lowercased/trimmed value before sanitisation. `status` becomes "published" only when the literal string "published" is sent — any other value (including omission) yields "draft". `publishedAt` is set to the current time when the post is created as published. `metaTitle` defaults to the title and `metaDescription` defaults to the excerpt when not provided. The author is taken from the authenticated admin user. The response returns only a compact reference to the created post.

400.description: Missing one or more required fields

example.error: Title, slug, content, excerpt, and category are required

401.description: Authentication required or token is invalid/expired

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the "admin" role

409.description: A blog post with this slug already exists

example.error: A post with this slug already exists

get.summary: List blog categories with post counts
get.description: Returns the blog categories that currently have at least one published post, together with the number of published posts in each, sorted by count in descending order. Categories with no published posts are not returned. The display `name` is derived from the category slug by replacing hyphens with spaces and title-casing each word (e.g. "buying-guides" becomes "Buying Guides"). This endpoint is public.

get.summary: Get a blog post by slug
get.description: Retrieves a single blog post, including its full HTML/markdown `content`, by its slug. This endpoint is public and performs no status check, so draft posts are also returned to anonymous callers if their slug is known.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The URL slug of the blog post

post.title: The Best Wireless Headphones of 2026
post.content: Wireless headphones have come a long way...
post.excerpt: Our picks for the best noise-cancelling wireless headphones you can buy right now.
post.metaDescription: Our picks for the best noise-cancelling wireless headphones you can buy right now.

404.description: No blog post exists with this slug

put.description: Updates an existing blog post identified by its slug. Requires the "admin" role. The body is `multipart/form-data`. All fields are optional and only supplied, non-empty values are applied — an empty string for `title`, `content`, `excerpt`, `category`, `metaTitle` or `metaDescription` leaves the current value unchanged. Sending `tags` as an empty string clears all tags. Sending `status=published` on a post that is not yet published flips it to published and stamps `publishedAt` with the current time; sending `status=draft` reverts it to draft (the existing `publishedAt` is kept). The post `slug` itself cannot be changed through this endpoint. A new `featuredImage` file replaces the previous image.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The URL slug of the blog post to update

post.description: Submits a message through the public contact form. This endpoint is fully public: no authentication is required and no token is read, so logged-out visitors can post. All four fields are trimmed before validation and are persisted in their trimmed form. The stored message always starts with a status of "new". Note that the API applies no rate limiting, honeypot field, or captcha, so submissions are unthrottled.

post.description: Creates a new discount coupon. Requires the 'admin' role. The code is trimmed and stored in uppercase, and must be unique. The expiry date must be in the future.

post.summary: Validate a coupon code against a cart total
post.description: Checks whether a coupon code can be applied to the given cart total and, if so, returns the calculated discount amount. Available to any authenticated user (buyer, seller, or admin); no specific role is required. The code is trimmed and uppercased before lookup. Validation fails when the coupon is inactive, expired, has reached its usage limit, or when the cart total is below the coupon's minimum order amount. For percentage coupons the discount is (cartTotal * discountValue) / 100, capped at maxDiscount when set; for fixed coupons the discount is the lesser of discountValue and cartTotal. The result is rounded to two decimal places. This endpoint does NOT increment the coupon's usedCount.

200.description: Coupon is valid for the supplied cart total

400.description: The request is missing code or cartTotal (plain error response), or the coupon exists but cannot be applied (response also includes "valid": false).

The referenced product must exist and the competitor price must be strictly lower than the product's current price. The new request is created with the status "pending" and empty admin notes. Requires the "buyer" or "admin" role — the "seller" role receives 403 Forbidden.

If the user has already upvoted, their ID is removed and the count is decremented by 1 (never below 0). Each user can therefore contribute at most one upvote. Requires authentication with the 'buyer' role; users with the 'admin' role are also allowed. No request body is read.

get.summary: List repair requests for the current user
get.description: Retrieves all repair requests created by the authenticated user, sorted by creation date in descending order (newest first). Any authenticated user (admin, buyer or seller) may call this endpoint; only that user's own repair requests are returned. Note: the response body is a bare JSON array, not an object envelope.

example.defectDescription: The left earcup produces no sound after two weeks of use.

401.description: Authentication required or token is invalid/expired

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while fetching repair requests

post.description: Creates a repair request for a product in one of the authenticated user's own orders. The request must be sent as multipart/form-data because it carries the warranty slip file, which is uploaded to Cloudinary. Any authenticated user (admin, buyer or seller) may call this endpoint. The referenced order must belong to the caller, must contain the given product, and must have status "delivered". The warranty slip must be a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF file no larger than 10 MB. Only one active repair request (status "pending", "scheduled" or "in_progress") may exist per order + product combination. The first entry of availabilitySlots is used as the scheduled date/time and the created request is stored with status "scheduled". Note: the response body is the bare repair request object, not an object envelope.

201.description: Repair request successfully created and scheduled

example.defectDescription: The left earcup produces no sound after two weeks of use.

400.description: Invalid request. Returned when a required field is missing ("Missing required fields"), the warranty slip is absent or empty ("Warranty slip is required"), the file type is not allowed ("Invalid file type. Allowed: JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF"), the file exceeds 10 MB ("File size must be less than 10MB"), availabilitySlots is not valid JSON ("Invalid availability slots format"), availabilitySlots is not a non-empty array ("At least one availability slot is required"), or the order has not been delivered ("Repair can only be requested for delivered orders").

example.error: Repair can only be requested for delivered orders

401.description: Authentication required or token is invalid/expired

404.description: The order does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user ("Order not found"), or the product is not part of that order ("Product not found in this order").

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred, for example the warranty slip upload to Cloudinary failed

CreateBlogPostRequest.description: Multipart form payload used to create a blog post

slug.description: Desired URL slug. Must be non-blank and must not collide with an existing post. It is lowercased, trimmed and sanitised (non `a-z0-9-` characters become `-`) before storage.

content.description: Full post body. Must be non-blank.
content.example: Wireless headphones have come a long way...

excerpt.example: Our picks for the best noise-cancelling wireless headphones you can buy right now.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags. Each entry is trimmed and lowercased; blank entries are dropped. Omit or send an empty string for no tags.

status.description: Send "published" to publish immediately (this also sets publishedAt). Any other value, including omission, results in a draft.

metaTitle.description: SEO title. Defaults to the post title when omitted or blank.

metaDescription.description: SEO description. Defaults to the excerpt when omitted or blank.
metaDescription.example: Our picks for the best noise-cancelling wireless headphones you can buy right now.

featuredImage.description: Optional featured image file. Uploaded to Cloudinary; empty files are ignored.

UpdateBlogPostRequest.description: Multipart form payload used to update a blog post. Every field is optional; only supplied, non-empty values are applied (the sole exception is `tags`, where an empty string clears all tags). The slug cannot be changed.

title.description: New post title. Ignored when blank.

content.description: New post body. Ignored when blank.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, replacing the existing set. An empty string clears all tags.

status.description: Send "published" to publish a post that is not yet published (sets publishedAt to now), or "draft" to unpublish it. Any other value leaves the status unchanged.

metaTitle.description: New SEO title. Ignored when blank.

metaDescription.description: New SEO description. Ignored when blank.

featuredImage.description: Optional replacement featured image file. Uploaded to Cloudinary; empty files are ignored.

ContactMessageListResponse.description: Response containing a list of contact messages

messages.description: Array of contact messages, newest first

discountValue.description: The discount amount: a percentage (1-100) when discountType is 'percentage', otherwise a fixed currency amount

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum cart total required for the coupon to apply. Defaults to 0.

maxDiscount.description: Maximum discount cap for percentage coupons. Always null for fixed coupons, and null when no cap was set.

usageLimit.description: Maximum number of times the coupon may be used

usedCount.description: Number of times the coupon has been used so far. Defaults to 0.

isActive.description: Whether the coupon is currently active. Defaults to true.

CreateCouponRequest.description: Request body for creating a coupon

code.description: The coupon code. Trimmed and converted to uppercase before being stored; must not already exist.

discountType.description: Whether the discount is a percentage of the cart total or a fixed amount

discountValue.description: Must be greater than 0. When discountType is 'percentage' it must be between 1 and 100.

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum cart total required for the coupon to apply. Defaults to 0 when omitted or falsy.

maxDiscount.description: Optional cap on the discount for percentage coupons. Ignored (stored as null) when discountType is 'fixed'.

usageLimit.description: Maximum number of times the coupon may be used

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the coupon expires. Must be in the future.

UpdateCouponRequest.description: Request body for updating a coupon. Only isActive is honoured, and only when it is a boolean.

isActive.description: New active state for the coupon. Any non-boolean value leaves the coupon unchanged.

ValidateCouponRequest.description: Request body for validating a coupon against a cart total

code.description: The coupon code to validate. Trimmed and uppercased before lookup.

cartTotal.description: The current cart total the discount should be calculated against

CouponListResponse.description: Response containing a list of coupons

CouponValidationResponse.description: Successful coupon validation result with the calculated discount

valid.description: Always true for a successful validation

code.description: The matched coupon code, in uppercase

discountAmount.description: The discount to subtract from the cart total, rounded to two decimal places and capped by maxDiscount (percentage coupons) or by the cart total (fixed coupons)

CouponValidationErrorResponse.description: Failed coupon validation result. When the coupon was found but cannot be applied (or was not found at all), the body also includes "valid": false; when the request itself was malformed only the error field is present.

valid.description: Present and false when the coupon could not be applied. Absent when the request body was missing code or cartTotal.

error.description: Human-readable reason the coupon could not be applied

description.example: The left earcup arrived cracked and the headband is bent.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the buyer. Empty string when not supplied.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for the reviewing admin
